I replied to Ilse in the #north-random thread. I noted her correction that the deadline for Tamsin Cold Chain's signed order form is 24 September, and took no other action, as she asked.

I also pointed out that today is 14 October on the simulation clock, so 24 September has already passed. I asked her to tell me if she meant a later date.

The signing date counts as an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to repeat in the channel. I didn't open #north-team to look at her earlier post, since she didn't ask me to.
